extends: follower_constitution_v0_1 (RATIFIED, sha-pinned, NOT MODIFIED by this addendum)

TP2_TAKE.rule: bank 50% of current open at instruction-bar close (same shape as instruction-driven TP1)

HOLD_RUNNER.rule: annotation only; runner already holds by P13

CANCEL_LIMITS.rule: cancel unfilled legs only; filled legs unaffected

REVISED_STOP.rule: posted SL replaced FORWARD-ONLY from the instruction bar; earlier resolved bars never recomputed; missing level -> fail closed

INVALIDATION.rule: no fills -> cancel unfilled, NO_FILL; open position -> PAUSED_NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW

RE_ENTER.rule: annotation on the current campaign; a re-entry is a NEW campaign created upstream

plus50_decision.question: is '+50 pips take partial' an evidenced executable follower rule?
plus50_decision.evidence: STATED by Farouk as his default (Model-B basis, FOLLOWER_FILL_EXPECTANCY_REPORT_v0_1B.md: '50% at +50p (his universal stated rule)'), BUT his actual posted management frequently overrides it (34-setup corpus; F001 banked at ~+26p and ~+90p claims; F002 at ~+39p), and ratified constitution P09 already rules: RECORDED as context, NEVER auto-executed.
plus50_decision.conclusion: INDEPENDENTLY EVIDENCED AS A STATED RULE, NOT AS ACTUAL BEHAVIOUR -> remains NON-EXECUTING per ratified P09. Implemented ONLY as a disabled sensitivity DIAGNOSTIC (plus50_diagnostic field: first bar where +50p from running average entry was reachable). It moves no state, banks nothing, affects neither lane.
plus50_decision.activation: would require explicit Martyn ratification of a constitution revision (v0.2)

mae_mfe_definition: excursion vs RUNNING fill-weighted average entry, evaluated per completed bar from first fill to close/data-end; MAE = worst adverse, MFE = best favourable, pips (0.1 USD)
smart_entry_boundary: ORANGE_SMART_ENTRY interface exists DISABLED; cannot alter STRICT_FOLLOWER, cannot write authoritative outcomes, separate ledger, no live activation
